study.notes: Extractor: Cowork agent. Date: 2026-05-25. Three-hospital retrospective cohort with clear inclusion/exclusion. Multivariable Cox regression adjusted for SAPS II, cardiac disease, appropriate definitive treatment. 9/83 eligible (10.8%) excluded from final analysis for missing clinical data (attrition flag, slightly >10%). TTP automatically measured by BACTEC 9240. Funded by German Centre of Infection Research (DZIF) with no role in study. Reviewers blinded to TTP results. Note: HR direction for TTP <=18h means SHORT TTP associated with HIGHER mortality (HR 3.83).

population.empiric_abx_definition: appropriate empirical treatment (AET) = systemic administration of at least one antimicrobial agent to which isolate was in vitro susceptible, delivered within 24h after blood cultures obtained; aminoglycoside monotherapy not deemed appropriate
population.incubation_protocol: BACTEC 9240, BACTEC PLUS aerobic/anaerobic bottles, ~10 mL blood each; CO2 detection every 10 min; final analysis on aerobic bottle TTP
population.notes: Age range 18-88, 48.65% >65y. SAPS II reported but mean/median not given for whole cohort (medians by survival shown: deaths 40 [31-48] vs recovery 31 [22-40]). 60.8% AET overall (45/74). Hematologic cancer 36.49%, cardiovascular disease 55.41%, neutropenia 39.19%. Sources: unknown/primary 40.54%, secondary 50%, urinary 20.27%, respiratory 20.27%, ICR 9.46%.

ttp.notes: Primary cutpoint TTP <=18h (n=53) vs >18h (n=21) selected by ROC analysis (AUC 0.6237) and best HR in Cox regression. Also reported cutpoints 15h and 17h. TTP measured from aerobic bottles. Continuous TTP also analyzed with HR 0.9291 per hour increase (univariate) and 0.9293 (adjusted).

outcomes.adjustment_vars: SAPS II; cardiac disease; appropriate definitive treatment (ADT)
outcomes.notes: Multivariable Cox HR 3.83 for TTP<=18h vs >18h. Mortality 22/53 (41.5%) in <=18h group vs 3/21 (14.3%) in >18h group (p=0.03 chi-sq). Overall mortality 25/74 (33.78%). Univariate HR for TTP<=18h was 3.0475 (0.9111-10.1931), p=0.038. Continuous TTP adjusted HR 0.9293 (0.868-0.9949) per hour, p=0.009 - i.e. ~7% mortality decrease per hour increase in TTP.

outcomes.outcome_definition: in-hospital mortality - continuous TTP per hour
outcomes.adjustment_vars: SAPS II; cardiac disease; appropriate definitive treatment (ADT)
outcomes.notes: Continuous TTP per 1-hour increase, adjusted Cox HR. Note this is HR (not OR) but recorded in or_per_hour for downstream meta-analysis convenience; HR <1 means longer TTP protective.

study.notes: Extractor: Cowork agent. Date: 2026-05-25. Single cancer-center, retrospective. Mortality NOT included in multivariable model (multivariate only assessed predictors of TTP itself, not of mortality). Mortality reported only as univariate chi-square by TTP cutpoint. No adjustment for severity/age/comorbidity/empiric therapy in mortality analysis (rob_comparability=3). Cutpoints chosen heuristically (8h for Enterobacteriaceae, 18h for others) rather than ROC. Patients with polymicrobial bacteremia, fungemia, <18y, or who received antimicrobial therapy before culture excluded. Funded by National Natural Science Foundation of China and other public sources.

population.pathogen_species: Enterobacteriaceae (E. coli, Klebsiella, Enterobacter, others), nonfermenters (P. aeruginosa, Xanthomonas, Acinetobacter, Burkholderia), staphylococci (CoNS, S. aureus), enterococci, streptococci, Candida

population.incubation_protocol: BACTEC FX400 (BD), aerobic/F and anaerobic Lytic/10 bottles, 8-10 mL blood, 35C for at least 5 days
population.notes: Cancer hospital cohort. 11.9% benign tumor, 88.9% malignant (24.2% GI cancer, 18.7% hepatocellular, 8.5% hematologic, 7.9% lung). Age/sex/ICU breakdowns reported only by TTP subgroup, not overall. From Table 3: across pathogen groups, ~40% age>65, 45-73% male, 14-39% ICU, 32-59% MDR.

ttp.notes: Overall mean TTP 14.19 +/- 8.13h. Different cutpoints per pathogen group (8h Enterobacteriaceae; 18h others); see per-arm rows below. Mean TTP by group: Enterobacteriaceae 11.39 +/- 7.21h, Nonfermenters 20.90 +/- 14.02h, Gram-positive 20.64 +/- 9.94h. Categorical distribution per Fig 1.

study.notes: Extractor: Cowork agent. Date: 2026-05-25. Single-center retrospective with all consecutive positive anaerobic blood cultures over 2 years (clear inclusion). Multivariable Cox model adjusted for age, sex, Charlson, CKD, diabetes with complications, adequate empiric AB, Clostridium spp, surgery within 30d, sepsis. TTP measured automatically (BD BACTEC Lytic Anaerobic) - low measurement bias. Mortality is 30-day all-cause from EMR. Funding 'no specific funding'. Multicollinearity addressed. Cutpoint median split is the main limitation. Note HR direction: TTP>=30h HR 0.24 means LONGER TTP protective; consistent with prior literature (shorter TTP -> higher mortality).

population.pathogen_species: Anaerobic bacteria: Bacteroides fragilis group 31.4%, Fusobacterium spp 17.1%, Clostridium spp 15.2%, Parvimonas 6.7%, Finegoldia 5.7%, others
population.empiric_abx_definition: antibiotic administered before reception of antibiogram had adequate spectrum of activity regarding the bacteria involved
population.incubation_protocol: BD BACTEC Lytic Anaerobic medium; identification by MALDI-TOF (Bruker Microflex LT)
population.notes: Sources: abdominal 35.2%, urinary 17.1%, primary 16.2%, osteoarticular 14.2%, pulmonary 12.3%, ENT 2.8%, vascular 1.9%. Polymicrobial infection 33.3% (anaerobic + concomitant aerobe). Mixed pathogen_class noted as anaerobic GN dominant (Bacteroides) + some GPAC; selected gram_negative since majority. Comorbidities: hypertension 38%, CHF 19%, AKI 28.5%, CKD 18%, diabetes 17%. Sepsis 29.5%, septic shock 13.3%. Surgical management 32.3%. 70.5% community-acquired. qSOFA median 1 (IQR 0-2).

ttp.notes: TTP dichotomized at median ~30h (text uses '>30 h' and 'TTP >= 30 h' interchangeably). n_short/n_long not explicitly tabulated; by median split each group is ~52-53. Median TTP differed by acquisition: nosocomial 29.1 (22.2-40.4), community 30.2 (19.1-48), p=0.74.

outcomes.outcome_definition: 30-day all-cause mortality from first positive blood culture
outcomes.adjustment_vars: age; sex; Charlson; CKD; diabetes with complications; adequate empirical antibiotic therapy; Clostridium spp bacteremia; surgery within past 30 days; sepsis
outcomes.notes: Multivariable Cox HR for TTP>=30h vs <30h. HR<1 means longer TTP protective. Overall 30-day mortality 23/105 (21.9%). Univariate HR 0.17 (0.06-0.49), p=0.001. Paper labels effect as 'OR' but it is actually HR from Cox proportional hazards model.
